required_evidence: A refutation must give an actual commutative ring and short exact sequence with finite free B and cyclic C.
Verify that the actual localized quotient map admits a linear right inverse at every prime ideal, not only at a selected family of evaluation primes.
Prove that the original global quotient map admits no R-linear right inverse, or otherwise refute a requested universal conclusion.
critical_errors: Replace splitting at every prime localization by splitting on a finite principal-open cover without proof.
Treat a cyclic or finitely generated module as automatically finitely presented.
Infer projectivity from flatness and finite generation alone.
Check only the coordinate evaluation primes of an infinite product ring.
Name a nonprojective module without checking the given short exact sequence and all localization hypotheses.
Prove nonexistence of a chosen formula for a section while leaving other global sections unaddressed.
completion_policy: Any complete legal counterexample to global existence completes the universal target. The Boolean product ring is one route, not a mandated example. A full prime-ideal classification, a finite-presentation repair theorem, an additional flatness proof or a general torsor theory is not required after a valid refutation.
open_task_policy: Accept every independently verified alternative proof, counterexample or unexpected result within the actual hypotheses. Explicit conditional results are separate contributions; silently promoting them to completion of the original task is not. Honest incompleteness is distinct from an invalid proof.
